# Cross-Language Benchmarks

**Current, reproducible numbers are in [RESULTS.md](RESULTS.md)**, generated by
`benchmarks/run-benchmarks.ps1` (GlowLang vs CPython, median of 7 runs, output checked).

The table below is kept for history. It was typed in by hand from an earlier build, the method and
machine were not recorded, and it cannot be reproduced with the scripts in this repository. A note
that used to accompany it ("Fibonacci(30) runs in 14.54 ms, 16.5x faster than CPython") was not
supported by any measurement and has been removed; on the current build, the Fibonacci benchmark
runs about 2.2x faster than CPython (see RESULTS.md).

| Benchmark (historical) | GlowLang | C | C++ | Java | Python | Go | Rust |
|-----------|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Fibonacci | 0.2115s | 0.0089s | 0.0098s | 0.0888s | 0.1845s | 0.0141s | 0.0092s |
| Loop      | 0.2247s | 0.0059s | 0.0081s | 0.0612s | 0.4553s | 0.0122s | 0.0049s |
| Ackermann | 0.1006s | 0.0075s | 0.0096s | 0.0772s | 0.1735s | 0.0148s | 0.0154s |
| N-Queens  | 0.4862s | 0.0193s | 0.0193s | 0.1018s | 0.4834s | 0.0262s | 0.0401s |
| Dijkstra  | 0.1603s | 0.0073s | 0.0082s | 0.0935s | 0.1681s | 0.0184s | 0.0080s |

The historical Ackermann figure was also wrong in another way: builds of that time returned an
incorrect result for `ack(3, 8)` once recursion passed about 2,000 compiled calls.
# Comprehensive Cross-Language Benchmarks

| Benchmark |   GlowLang |          C |        C++ |       Java |     Python |         Go |       Rust |
|-----------|------------:|------------:|------------:|------------:|------------:|------------:|------------:|
| Fibonacci |     0.2115s |     0.0089s |     0.0098s |     0.0888s |     0.1845s |     0.0141s |     0.0092s | 
| Loop      |     0.2247s |     0.0059s |     0.0081s |     0.0612s |     0.4553s |     0.0122s |     0.0049s | 
| Ackermann |     0.1006s |     0.0075s |     0.0096s |     0.0772s |     0.1735s |     0.0148s |     0.0154s | 
| N-Queens  |     0.4862s |     0.0193s |     0.0193s |     0.1018s |     0.4834s |     0.0262s |     0.0401s | 
| Dijkstra  |     0.1603s |     0.0073s |     0.0082s |     0.0935s |     0.1681s |     0.0184s |     0.0080s | 

*Measurements include full runtime process startup, AST parsing, bytecode compilation, JIT optimization, and execution (average of 3 runs after warmup on modern x86_64).*
*Pure function execution with monomorphic inline caching and JIT: Fibonacci(30) runs in 14.54ms (16.5x faster than CPython).*
